label: Huawei SmartAX MA5801-FL04 box OLT
description: Huawei SmartAX MA5801-FL04 - 1U box OLT with 4 Flex-PON service ports (GPON, XG(S)-PON or XG(S)-PON&GPON Combo), 4x optical GE/10GE and 2x electrical GE/2.5GE upstream ports, 185 Gbit/s switching capacity and up to 512 ONTs.
notes: From the MA5801 model table: **4x optical GE/10GE **plus 2x electrical GE/2.5GE**** upstream and **4 Flex-PON** service ports, 185 Gbit/s switching capacity, 512 ONTs, 1U and under 5 kg, dual AC or DC supplies, -40 to +65 C. The GPON service ports carry the 2.5G/1.25G ladder this catalogue uses for every OLT (`[1244, 2488]`); the upstream ports are **GE/10GE** cages so both rates are on the ladder. As with the EA5801E family, the PON ferrule polish is not published on this page - `sc-apc` is the catalogue's PON convention and is inherited rather than quoted. **This member is wired differently from its siblings** and the table says so: 'Upstream ports: optical ports: 4 x GE/10GE, electrical ports: 2 x GE/2.5GE'. So it has four optical cages *and* two copper uplinks on a 2.5G ladder - a lab that reuses the GP16/GP08 shape would leave the copper uplinks out entirely. Flex-PON again, so the PON ladder reaches 9953.
